provenance.operation: Deterministic float64 forward replay of the public original-order target and saved replacement bundles; no training or new model selection.
provenance.formula: ReLU(onehot(a,b) @ incoming.T + hidden_bias) @ outgoing + output_bias; softmax over 19 answer logits.
provenance.interpretation: Softmax confidence is model-assigned probability, not a calibrated likelihood of being correct.
